Tang Capital Management Cut Holding in Heron Therapeutics (HRTX) by $3.19 Million as Share Value Rose; Savant Capital Lowered Its Marriott Intl New (MAR) Holding as Valuation Rose
May 12, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Savant Capital Llc decreased its stake in Marriott Intl Inc New (MAR) by 0.87% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Savant Capital Llc sold 2,226 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.21% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 254,864 shares of the hotels and resorts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.51M, down from 257,090 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Savant Capital Llc who had been investing in Marriott Intl Inc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $49.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.90% or $1.25 $139.82. About 1.18M shares traded. Marriott International, Inc. (NASDAQ:MAR) has risen 45.53% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.98% the S&P500.
